summary: Tested iteration 54 features: Import from Text (LLM parse) + Community Digest email graceful-fail + PasteTipsDialog in admin dashboard + Quick Guide 'Paste multiple tips' card. All backend and frontend flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1107 lines — consider splitting community/digest/parse routers into their own modules per the >700 line guideline.

RESEND_API_KEY/SENDER_EMAIL/ADMIN_DIGEST_EMAIL are read once at import time (module scope). If the .env is updated at runtime, the digest endpoint won't pick it up until backend restart — this is acceptable for launch but worth documenting.
parse_tips_from_text does an import of emergentintegrations inside the request handler. Fine for cold cost but consider moving to module scope for consistency.
test_credentials: ADMIN_TOKEN=irr-admin-8f3a2b91c4d7e6f5 (from /app/backend/.env); admin UI unlocked by localStorage.setItem('irr.admin_token', <token>).
seed_data_creation: Created ~2 pending tips with resource_id='TEST_iter54' via the Bulk paste UI during testing; ALL cleaned up via DELETE /api/community/tips/{id} at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file: /app/backend/tests/test_parse_and_digest.py — safe to re-run (uses ~1 real LLM call). Digest send returns 200 with ok:false when RESEND_API_KEY empty (correct graceful-fail). QuickGuide modal opens automatically on Home load — no separate launcher needed.
